newsitem.title: USA: Royal Caribbean files for $375 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Royal Caribbean files for $375 mln shelf.

text.p: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $375 million in debt securities and common and preferred stock.
When combined with a previous registation, Royal Caribbean will have a total offering of $600 million in securities available for sale, the filing said.
A. Wilhelmsen AS, a Norwegian Corp, which owns 24,745,000 common shares may offer from time to time up to two million common shares, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used for capital expenditures, the repayment of indebtedness, working capital and general corporate purposes, the filing said.
Royal Caribbean is provider of cruises to North American passengers as well as a leading provider of cruises in the Caribbean market.
